outcome: Immediate outcome of helix adhesion correction
Long-term outcome of helix adhesion correction
cohort: 46 newborns (66 ears) with helix adhesion treated with the EarWell System at the Eye and ENT Hospital of Fudan University between 2019 and 2021.
finding: The EarWell System was an effective method to correct auricular helix adhesion, achieving excellent or good immediate and long-term outcomes in over 95% of ears, with age of initiation treatment being a significant predictor of success.
